ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, notably Articles 3, 4, 8, 9 and 51; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto-ley 7/2021, de 27 de abril, transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843 and establishing the Central Beneficial Ownership Register; Real Decreto 95/2024, de 23 de enero, regulating the new centralized UBO information system under the Ministry of Justice; Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010) for corporate records.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Good Standing of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or corporate register in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague Convention member states; otherwise consular legalization by the Spanish Consulate of the issuing country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport or national identity document of each individual shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner and signatory officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government authority or licensed notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certification, sworn translation into Spanish, and Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (recent utility bill or official municipal register extract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, municipal authority or equivalent public registry in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy, sworn translation into Spanish, and Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter / AML KYC confirmation letter from the shareholder's or UBO's existing bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostilled or consular legalized, with sworn translation if issued in a non-Spanish language

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: If incorporation is executed through a legal representative, a specific Power of Attorney for incorporation and bank onboarding
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or equivalent competent authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus sworn translation into Spanish

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, authorized signatories and ultimate beneficial owners against the Spanish domestic sanctions lists published in the Official State Gazette (BOE), the SEPBLAC risk list, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the United Nations Security Council consolidated list and the OFAC SDN list. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons (PEPs), to persons connected with high-risk third countries and to transactions involving shell banks. Screening must be completed before incorporation and repeated on a risk-based continuing basis; suspicious transaction reports must be filed with SEPBLAC under Article 18 Ley 10/2010; records must be retained for a minimum of 10 years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) — online negative name certificate (certificado negativo de denominación) through Sede Electrónica and the Colegio de Registradores de España, accessible via www.rmc.es
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in the Latin alphabet. Spanish legal form endings 'S.L.' or 'Sociedad Limitada' are mandatory. Names must not be identical or phonetically confusingly similar to existing registered names, must not contain misleading references to activity or public authorities, and may be in Spanish, any co-official Spanish language or a foreign language only where the name is legible and conforms to the Latin script. The name must not infringe prior trademarks or well-known commercial names.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: and any denomination requiring prior ministerial or autonomous community authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name certificate is not used for application within the 30-day validity window, a fresh negative name certificate must be obtained or an extension requested as allowed by the Registro Mercantil Central operational notice. If the registrar rejects the proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (DGSJFP), attached to the harmful registry certificate and the application documentation, within one month of rejection. Alternatively, the applicant may request reconsideration before the Colegio de Registradores or submit a new proposed name through a renewed name search. A judicial appeal through the Spanish contentious-administrative jurisdiction is available after exhaustion of the administrative appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or administrative service address is permissible for the initial registered-office stage only if it corresponds to a physically locatable address in Spain where notifications, process service and regulatory communications can lawfully be accepted. P.O. boxes exclusively are not accepted. For an ISIC 5229 out-of-gauge cargo logistics and heavy-haul undertaking, the Spanish commercial registrars and tax authorities require real operational substance, an active place of management, tangible evidence of project cargo coordination, and staff presence in Spain; a virtual office alone is insufficient for Spanish tax residence and for customs and transport intermediary compliance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate annual probability of approximately 30–35% for an unannounced on-site inspection in the first financial year by SEPBLAC and the State Tax Agency (AEAT), rising to 45–55% if customs facilities authorizations, bonded warehouses, intra-EU transport licences or favourable tax deductions are requested. For a low-risk project-cargo entity with clean UBO filings, no sanctions hits and no high-risk jurisdiction exposure, the inspection probability remains below 20% until operational red flags are observed.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal review, drafting of shareholder and governance preparatory documents, and coordination of the notary signature

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market hourly or fixed-fee benchmark for Inbound corporate due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Obtaining provisional tax identification number (NIF provisional) and, where applicable, applying for the digital company certificate (certificado digital de persona jurídica)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Real Casa de la Moneda – Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tax-administration tariff and statutory digital-certification fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, of 2 July, approving the recast text of the Spanish Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), Articles 4, 12, 22, 26, 28, 133, 134 and 210; and the Regulation of the Commercial Registry (Real Decreto 1784/1996).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) for name certification; Registro Mercantil Provincial in the province of the registered office for inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public deed of incorporation) and the corresponding application for registration (solicitud de inscripción).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada requires a minimum subscribed share capital of €3,000. The full capital must be subscribed and unequivocally paid up before execution of the public deed. Cash contributions are proven by a bank deposit certificate; in-kind contributions require an independent expert valuation report under Article 38 LSC. No separate escrow account is required; notarial and registry fees are payable over and above the capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned shareholders of [COMPANY] Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, acting as the General Meeting, hereby approve and adopt the following resolutions: FIRST: Each shareholder applies for and subscribes the number of shares indicated in the subscription schedule, and this meeting approves the issued share capital of [€] as set out in the deed of incorporation. SECOND: The registered office is established at [ADDRESS], [CITY], Province of [PROVINCE], Spain. THIRD: The following persons are appointed as officers: [NAME] as Sole Director (Administrador Único) and [NAME], if desired, as Secretary, to represent the Company in accordance with the bylaws. FOURTH: The directors are authorised to take all steps and sign all documents necessary to complete statutory registration and tax formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve the Company Name (Certificación Negativa de Denominación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed application to the Central Commercial Registry requesting certification that the proposed corporate name is not legally prejudicial or confusingly similar. The application must be signed by all founding partners and must list up to three alternative names.
required_dossiers: Up to three alternative proposed corporate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected for similarity or identity, file a corrected request using alternative names. Any negative certification may be appealed before the Registry within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Bank Account and Deposit Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish commercial bank or credit institution selected by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Provide the draft deed and bylaws to the bank, complete anti-money-laundering and know-your-customer procedures, and deposit the full minimum share capital (€3,000) into a provisional incorporation account. The bank will issue a certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito) for presentation to the notary.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID and NIE of all shareholders
Draft deed of incorporation and corporate bylaws
Anti-money laundering declaration and beneficial ownership statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC documentation, supply source-of-funds information or corporate records. A defective deposit certificate must be re-issued by the bank before the notarial appointment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute Public Deed of Incorporation Before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary competent for the district of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend the chosen notary office and execute the deed of incorporation. The notary verifies the name certificate, the bank deposit certificate and the bylaws, and will request the provisional tax identification number (NIF provisional) immediately after execution.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate from Registro Mercantil Central
Bank deposit certificate evidencing the subscribed capital
DNI/NIE of all shareholder-partners and of the appointed director(s)
Independent expert valuation report for any non-cash contribution, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects a legal defect or requires amendments to the bylaws, the deed must be corrected and re-executed. A written record of the refusal or query will be provided for legal remedy.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Provisional NIF and Register the Company in the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Registro Mercantil Provincial where the registered office is domiciled
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary automatically transmits the deed to the AEAT for issuance of the provisional NIF and to the Provincial Commercial Registry for inscription. File Form 036 in parallel to complete the entrepreneurial census registration. The registry inscription must be requested within the statutory 15 business days following execution.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Certified copy of the deed for registry use
Notary's informative communication to the Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry returns a qualification note with defects, correct the deed within the two-month grace period and re-present. NIF issuance errors may be rectified directly at the AEAT office or online within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Definitive NIF and Complete Social Security Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verifying the Mercantile Registry's positive inscription, file the definitive NIF application with the AEAT. If the company will hire employees, complete the employer registration with the TGSS and file the corresponding season of contracts.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registry inscription (acreditación de inscripción)
Registered copy of the deed of incorporation
Employment contracts and notification forms, if hiring
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the definitive NIF is delayed, request an interim certificate and ensure the registry transmission has been received. For TGSS discrepancies, submit a written cure through the local administration office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No applicable industrial licensing board for the primary project-cargo logistics coordination activity. Where the company itself operates heavy goods vehicles, the Dirección General de Transporte Terrestre (Ministry of Transport, Mobility and Urban Agenda) is the competent authority for freight transport authorizations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific operating license is required for the logistics coordination entity as such. Operation of heavy-haul vehicles would require an 'Autorización de Transporte de Mercancías' (goods transport authorization) or special traffic permits from the Dirección General de Tráfico for oversized loads.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt under Law 21/2013, as the activity comprises administrative logistics and warehousing without an industrial installation. No EIA report or preliminary registration is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater discharges or significant VOC emissions arise from the primary administration and coordination operations. If ancillary warehousing holds fuel or heavy equipment, compliance with Royal Decree 840/2015 and local wastewater discharge limits will apply only if established thresholds are exceeded.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Compliance with Law 31/1995 on the prevention of occupational risks. A municipal activity and fire-safety license (licencia de apertura/actividad) must be obtained for the registered office/warehouse. Structural load inspection under the Technical Building Code is required for any storage facility. Work centres must be assessed by an accredited occupational risk-prevention service.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) with non-resident shareholders: (1) The SL must obtain a provisional NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) through the notary during incorporation, followed by a definitive NIF from the AEAT within two months of registration in the Commercial Registry. (2) Foreign investors without a permanent establishment must apply for a non-resident NIF (NIE) at the local police station or consulate; this NIE is subsequently used for corporate filings. (3) For VAT purposes, the SL must register for Spanish IVA (VAT) using Form 036 before commencing economic activity, stating the legal entity's NIF and planned activity codes (IAE). (4) Non-EU shareholders must appoint a tax representative for service of documents and to ensure compliance with Spanish tax obligations. (5) All applications are filed electronically with AEAT digital certificate or by authorized apoderado.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not provide a check-the-box regime. However, entities may elect for: (i) Consolidated Corporate Income Tax filing for groups under Article 64 of the Spanish Corporate Income Tax Law (LIS); (ii) Participation exemption election for qualifying dividends and capital gains from non-resident subsidiaries; (iii) Tax consolidation and horizontal merger elections; and (iv) hybrid mismatch adjustments under EU ATAD directives, with mandatory filing of Form 231 for cross-border mismatches. Elections are made via Form 036 to the AEAT in advance of the fiscal year.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold; any business performing taxable supplies or establishments in Spanish territory must register before commencement. A non-resident contractor is required to register for IVA if any supply is deemed to be made in Spain, irrespective of annual turnover, subject to refund rights under Directive 2008/9/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain mandates electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) between private entities under the 'Crea y Crece' law, with phased implementation from 2025 for large businesses and 2026 for SMEs. The AEAT's Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) imposes real-time electronic bookkeeping of invoices and expense receipts via web services (XML schema) for taxpayers with annual turnover exceeding €6 million or those opting into the system. Additionally, Verifactu (Reglamento de Facturación, Real Decreto 1007/2023) requires certified invoice software that generates an integrity hash and transmits a record to AEAT upon issuance, effectively a quasi-clearance mandate for all B2B invoices. Non-resident taxpayers issuing invoices concerning Spanish activities must comply with the same digital structure. Forms and API endpoints are documented in the AEAT's SII technical specifications (version 4.0 and later).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to non-European Union destinations are zero-rated (0% IVA) under Article 21 of Spanish VAT Law (LIVA 37/1992), provided the exporter (a) proves dispatch within the time limits, (b) holds a customs export declaration (DUA) accepted by Spanish Customs, and (c) goods physically leave Spanish territory within the statutory reporting period (generally immediately upon export). Services directly related to export of goods (e.g., freight handling, loading supervision for out-of-gauge project cargo, port wraparound) qualify as zero-rated if rendered to a non-established customer and directly connected to the exported goods. Intra-EU supplies are zero-rated only after recording the customer's EU VAT number. For project cargo logistics, documentation must evidence the specific link between the service and the actual export movement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA – Documento Único Administrativo) accepted by Spanish Customs
Commercial invoice and packing list referencing the customs export declaration number
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) evidencing movement to a non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRM) or bank SWIFT/FX transaction record showing collection of payment from non-resident counterparty
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEAT applies a strict verification of export zero-rating claims. Fraudulent or erroneous zero-rating attracts recapture of the deducted input VAT plus late-payment interest and penalty surcharges under the General Tax Law (LGT 58/2003). Penalties range from 50% to 150% of the tax amount determined by contrafact; in aggravated cases of intentional omission or false documentation, the penal surcharge can reach 150% with potential criminal liability under the Spanish Criminal Code for tax fraud. In addition, the exporter forfeits the right to use the Refu (refund) mechanism and may face suspension of NIF or triggering of secondary liability.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties_no: If export documentation is not fully available at the time of the AEAT review, the zero-rating is reversed to 21% IVA, plus recapture of any deducted input VAT, and 20% late-payment interest (per Article 26 LGT) is applied from the date the return was due. The taxpayer bears the burden of proving the goods left the EU with an external common transit procedure or pre-notification via ICS; failure to provide such proof results in an immediate assessment and disqualification of the export invoice.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under a fully convertible Euro currency regime with open capital and current accounts. Profit remittances to foreign parents face no prior approval requirements beyond standard AML/KYC, CRS, and DAC6 reporting. Hurdles are confined to beneficial ownership verification and source-of-funds documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds applies to most transactions. Repatriation must occur promptly per contractual terms, typically within 30-90 days. Banks file Suspicious Transaction Reports and customs-linked declarations for VAT/export compliance; no statutory conversion ratios are mandated.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for licensed EMI cross-border operations under PSD2 and MiFID II; Spanish SL entities may use regulated digital platforms for offshore settlements provided full AML/KYC and local payment institution licensing are maintained.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital KYC and onboarding is fully permitted for Spanish SL companies via certified platforms. Physical appearance of directors is not mandatory for standard onboarding but required for high-value transactions or elevated risk flags.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or unreported changes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Registro Mercantil certificate, updated ownership structure, and independent source-of-wealth verification

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Project cargo counterparties linked to high-risk jurisdictions or sanctions exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence reports, insurance certificates, legal opinions on export controls, and transaction pattern analysis

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent funding sources or unusual payment volumes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolutions, bank confirmation letters, and audited financial statements demonstrating legitimate project financing

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections use SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' or 'CAPITAL INJECTION'. Verification requires Spanish incorporation documents, board resolutions, and source-of-funds evidence. All flows must satisfy CRS, DAC6, and Spanish tax authority reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound project cargo disbursements are cleared via SWIFT MT103 for milestone payments or issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600. LCs are preferred for heavy-haul logistics to secure delivery confirmations and reduce FX exposure.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps and cross-currency basis swaps

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Cuentas Anuales (Annual Accounts Deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after shareholder approval; accounts must be approved within 6 months of fiscal year-end; for calendar-year SL due by 30 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit triggers automatic closure of the company's registry sheet after 2 consecutive years; monetary fines of EUR 300-1,200 for late filing; continued default leads to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Impuesto sobre Sociedades – Form 200 (Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 25 days after the 6-month period following the tax year; calendar-year filers due by 25 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge up to 20% plus late-payment interest; penalty of 50%-150% of tax due; habitual non-filing can result in criminal prosecution and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Form 347 – Declaración Anual de Operaciones con Terceras Personas (Annual Third-Party Transactions Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1-28 February for preceding calendar year; mandatorily report if transactions with any counterparty exceed EUR 3,005.06
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of EUR 300-20,000 depending on omitted transaction volume or incorrect data; 2% fine on undisclosed amount if omitted values exceed EUR 50,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Form 232 – Declaración Informativa de Operaciones Vinculadas (Related-Party Transactions Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as Form 200, calendar-year filers due 1-25 July; required when related-party transactions exceed EUR 250,000 per counterparty
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of EUR 1,000 per omitted item with minimum EUR 10,000; incorrect data subject to EUR 250 per item; deliberate omission may trigger special tax audit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Form 390 – Resumen Anual de IVA (Annual VAT Summary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1-30 January following the calendar year; reconciles quarterly or monthly VAT returns
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 50%-150% of VAT due plus interest; continued failure may lead to suspension of VAT registration and administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for two consecutive years if at least two of these exceed: balance sheet total > EUR 4,000,000; net turnover > EUR 8,000,000; average employees > 50. Groups and certain regulated sector companies require audit irrespective of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Real Decreto 1514/2007, Plan General Contable); IFRS-EU required for consolidated accounts of listed groups; accounts must be presented in euros and Spanish.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain an internal UBO register and a share-transfer register at its registered office. Every share transfer requires notarized public deed, entry in the Register of Members, and updated UBO declaration filed with the Registro Mercantil within 30 days. No separate annual UBO return is due except when changes occur; in a year of transfer, the annual accounts deposit must reflect the post-transfer ownership and the share transfer register must be presented for audit upon request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,300 - USD 3,200 per year for commercial registered office and corporate agent services in Madrid or Barcelona
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,800 - USD 8,600 for a certified statutory audit of a project cargo logistics SL

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holidays. Newly created SLs may apply 15% on the first EUR 300,000 of taxable base for the first two profitable tax periods, 25% on the excess. R&D credits 25%–42%, employment credits, and indefinite tax-loss carryforward subject to annual offset caps: no cap if turnover <EUR 20 million; 70% cap if turnover EUR 20–60 million; 50% cap if turnover >EUR 60 million (minimum EUR 1 million may always be offset).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Modelo 200) – Annual Corporate Income Tax Return – filed electronically via the AEAT portal (Sede Electrónica) using approved XML/PDF format under CESICE.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 calendar days after the six-month period following the tax year-end. For calendar-year SLs, due by 25 July.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: NIF, registered corporate name, address, legal form, accounting reference period, fiscal year-end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident without a permanent establishment (PE): do not file Form 200; withholding taxes are settled by the payer/withholding agent. Non-resident with a PE: file Form 200 with the PE’s NIF and report only the PE’s results.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit before corporate income tax (resultado contable antes de impuestos).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident PE, report the accounting profit attributable to the Spanish PE under the separate-entity fiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent book-tax adjustments: increases and decreases to reconcile accounting profit to taxable income (e.g., non-deductible expenses, exempt dividends, participation exemption).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include adjustments specific to the PE, such as expatriate costs, head-office expense allocation, and tax-haven source adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year negative tax bases (compensación de bases imponibles negativas).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the same limitation rules as a resident company; losses must be traceable to the Spanish PE’s activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base (base imponible) after loss offset.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE uses its own separate taxable base; no consolidation with the foreign head office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate: 25% general (or 15% for new SLs on first EUR 300,000; 20% for certain agriculture/hunting entities if applicable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE is taxed at 25%; the reduced new-entity rate is not available to a non-resident PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross tax liability, deductions/credits, withholdings, instalments paid, and final result – tax payable or refunded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE may apply treaty credits and Spanish unilateral credits for foreign-source income only if attributable to the PE.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without previous AEAT request: 5% surcharge for up to 3 months, 10% for 4–6 months, 15% for 7–12 months, 20% if more than 12 months, plus late-payment interest. Underpayment due to inaccurate filings: 50%–150% under Art. 191 LGT. Incorrectly filed self-assessments: 5%–100% under Art. 192 LGT. Repeated non-filing or obstruction may trigger indirect estimation and criminal liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% domestic non-resident withholding tax (IRNR) on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders without a PE. Reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive where the EU parent holds at least 5% of the Spanish SL for an uninterrupted 12 months; DTT rates may reduce from 0% to 15% depending on the residence state.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To obtain treaty/Directive relief, the non-resident shareholder must provide the paying Spanish entity with a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the beneficial owner's tax authority before the dividend payment date. The Spanish payer must retain the original TRC in the withholding file and submit the annual Form 231 declaration of payments to non-residents and Form 216 summary return of withheld taxes. If excess withholding has been applied, the non-resident may claim a refund by filing Form 210/211 within the applicable limitation period (normally four years).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic IRNR rates: interest 19%; royalties 24%. The EU Interest & Royalties Directive can exempt qualifying interest and royalties paid to EU associated companies from Spanish withholding, provided the beneficial ownership and substance conditions are met. Typical DTT rates: interest 0%–10%; royalties 5%–10% (e.g., US-Spain treaty: interest 10% for unrelated, 5% for related; royalties 8%–10%).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Documentation under Art. 18 LIS and Royal Decree 634/2015 is mandatory when net turnover equals or exceeds EUR 10,000,000. Entities below this threshold are exempt from full Master File/Local File unless the transactions are with related residents of tax havens, or the entity carries out specifically high-value related-party transactions exceeding EUR 250,000 with the same related party in accordance with implementing regulations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not apply GCC-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR). However, economic substance is enforced through: (i) the statutory general anti-abuse clause (Art. 15 LGT) and substance-over-form doctrine; (ii) the participation exemption under Art. 21 LIS requiring a minimum 5% shareholding and a substantive management-and-activity test; (iii) CFC rules under Art. 91 LIS; and (iv) the requirement that the Spanish SL engaged in OOG heavy project cargo logistics has sufficient employees, premises, and operational decisions to avoid being characterised as a shell or letterbox entity under EU ATAD and Spanish case law.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully omitting taxable income, overstating deductible costs, or using false invoices in a Spanish SL when the evaded tax exceeds EUR 120,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment from 2 to 6 years (aggravated if over EUR 600,000 or organised), fines up to 6 times the evaded amount, and loss of tax benefits/subsidies for up to 10 years. In addition, the tax debt plus late-payment interest is fully claimable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director who signs suspicious returns or orders fraudulent dealings is jointly and several liable for the tax debt under Art. 42 LGT and may be prosecuted as an authorised or procurement participant under Arts. 305–310 Penal Code, facing the same imprisonment and fines, plus travel bans and asset seizures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an SL that is invoicing or shunting project cargo income without real employees, premises, economic activity, or decision-making in Spain; directing profits to a related entity in a tax-haven or zero-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AEAT may recharacterise or disregard the artificial transaction under the GAAR (Art. 15 LGT) and apply a 50% penalty on the resulting underpayment (Art. 206bis LGT). Denial of treaty benefits and EU Directive benefits follows; potential criminal charge for tax fraud if the recharacterised income exceeds the criminal threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly incorporated or used a shell vehicle for tax avoidance can be personally and severally liable for the corporate tax debt under Art. 43 LGT if the company is stripped of assets or insolvent. In court proceedings, travel restrictions and gagging/asset-freezing orders may be imposed, and criminal money-laundering charges may be added.
